description: This file is a FastAPI-based web application demonstrating WebSocket communication with an HTML frontend. It defines routes for serving a WebSocket chat and handles cookie/query parameter authentication.

methods.name: get()
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request at root '/', returns the chat HTML page.

methods.name: get_cookie_or_token( websocket: WebSocket, session: Annotated[str | None, Cookie()] = None, token: Annotated[str | None, Query()] = None, )
methods.description: Dependency function that extracts session cookie or token query parameter for WebSocket connection authentication.

methods.name: websocket_endpoint( *, websocket: WebSocket, item_id: str, q: int | None = None, cookie_or_token: Annotated[str, Depends(get_cookie_or_token)], )
methods.description: WebSocket handler for a specific item ID, echoes back messages with session token or cookie details.
